title: Technical Recruiter
description:
**Job Title: Technical Recruiter**

**Experience:** 1–2 Years**Working Days:** Monday to Friday**Working Hours:** 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM

**About the Role**

We are looking for a proactive and result\-oriented Technical Recruiter to join our HR team. The ideal candidate should have experience in end\-to\-end IT recruitment, with the ability to source, screen, and hire top technical talent. Experience in hiring for cybersecurity roles will be an added advantage.

**Key Responsibilities**

· Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle, from requirement gathering to candidate onboarding.

· Work closely with hiring managers to understand technical hiring requirements.

· Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, employee referrals, social media, and other sourcing channels.

· Screen resumes and conduct initial HR interviews to assess technical skills, communication, and cultural fit.

· Coordinate technical interviews with hiring managers and interview panels.

· Schedule interviews and ensure a smooth candidate experience throughout the hiring process.

· Negotiate salary, prepare offer letters, and manage the offer rollout process.

· Follow up with selected candidates until successful onboarding.

· Maintain recruitment trackers, candidate databases, and hiring reports.

· Build and maintain a strong pipeline of technical candidates for current and future hiring needs.

· Ensure recruitment targets are achieved within the defined timelines.

· Participate in employer branding, campus recruitment, and recruitment events when required.

**Required Skills**

· Strong understanding of the IT recruitment lifecycle.

· Good knowledge of the cybersecurity domain.

· Excellent sourcing skills using LinkedIn, Naukri, indeed, GitHub, and other recruitment platforms.

· Hands\-on experience with Boolean Search and advanced sourcing techniques.

· Excellent communication, interpersonal, and negotiation skills.

· Ability to prioritise multiple positions and meet hiring deadlines.

· Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, Microsoft Office, and Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS).

Pay: ₹16,000\.00 \- ₹19,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Hiring for FP&A Analyst
description:
**Job description**

Boson Motors seeks an **FP\&A Analyst** to provide financial analysis, planning, and reporting to support executive decision\-making. Report to CFO and partner with operations, manufacturing, and sales teams to build financial models, track performance, and deliver actionable insights driving strategic growth.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop financial models for revenue, expense, and cash flow forecasting; build quarterly/annual budgets
* Conduct variance analysis and scenario planning (base/best/worst case) for executive decision\-support
* Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports; create KPI dashboards and executive presentations
* Analyze unit economics, gross margin, and cost optimization opportunities
* Support investor relations, capital planning, and ad\-hoc strategic financial analysis
* Improve forecasting processes and automate reporting workflows

Required Qualifications

* **Education:** Bachelor's in Finance, Accounting, Business, or related field
* **Experience:** 2\-4 years in FP\&A, corporate finance, or financial analysis; startup/growth\-stage environment preferred
* **Technical:** Advanced Excel (modeling, pivot tables, data consolidation); experience with financial planning software ; data visualization tools
* **Skills:** Strong quantitative analysis, financial statement understanding, unit economics, scenario modeling; excellent communication and presentation abilities
* **Mindset:** Detail\-oriented, adaptable, collaborative, comfortable with ambiguity in fast\-paced environment

Preferred Qualifications

* EV, automotive, or renewable energy sector experience(preferrable)
* Manufacturing/supply chain financial analysis(Preferrable)
* Any other sectors

Key Deliverables

* Monthly management reporting packs (P\&L, variance analysis, KPI dashboards)
* Quarterly forecast updates and variance commentaries
* Annual budget and long\-range financial plan (3\-5 years)
* Executive presentations and board\-ready materials
* Ad\-hoc analyses supporting strategic decisions (2\-4 per quarter)
* Financial models and scenario analyses as needed

Pay: ₹500,000\.00 \- ₹900,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund
* Work from home

Work Location: In person

title: Recruiter
description:
We are looking for a proactive and result\-oriented Talent Acquisition / Recruitment professional with hands\-on experience in both IT and Non\-IT recruitment. The candidate will be responsible for managing end\-to\-end recruitment, building talent pipelines, coordinating with hiring managers, and ensuring timely closure of positions.

**Key Responsibilities**

· Manage end\-to\-end recruitment from manpower requirement to candidate joining.

· Handle IT, Non\-IT, Volume/Bulk, Managerial and Niche hiring across various functions.

· Understand hiring requirements and prepare/finalize Job Descriptions (JDs) with stakeholders.

· Source candidates through Naukri, LinkedIn, job portals, employee referrals, social media, databases, consultants and direct sourcing.

· Screen resumes and conduct initial telephonic/video interviews to assess technical/functional skills, experience, communication, notice period, compensation and role fit.

· Coordinate technical, functional, managerial and HR interview rounds and ensure timely feedback.

· Build and maintain talent pipelines and candidate databases for current and future requirements.

· Manage salary discussions, offer approvals, offer rollout and pre\-joining follow\-up to improve offer\-to\-join conversion.

· Ensure positions are closed within defined recruitment TAT/SLA while maintaining candidate quality.

· Prepare recruitment MIS and dashboards covering vacancies, pipeline, interviews, selections, offers, joining, TAT and source effectiveness.

· Track and control recruitment costs related to portals, consultants, advertisements and other hiring activities.

· Support recruitment drives, employee referrals, campus hiring and other talent acquisition initiatives.

· Stay updated on market trends, talent availability, salary trends, emerging skills and recruitment best practices.

· Leverage ATS, recruitment technology and AI\-based sourcing/screening tools to improve recruitment efficiency.

**Required Skills \& Experience**

· 2–5 years of hands\-on recruitment / talent acquisition experience.

· Proven experience in both IT and Non\-IT recruitment.

· Experience in volume hiring and managerial/niche recruitment will be an advantage.

· Strong sourcing and headhunting skills with hands\-on experience in Naukri, LinkedIn and other recruitment platforms.

· Good understanding of technical and functional candidate screening.

· Strong communication, negotiation, stakeholder management and follow\-up skills.

· Experience with ATS / recruitment databases.

· Strong working knowledge of Advanced MS Excel and recruitment MIS/analytics.

· Familiarity with AI\-enabled recruitment tools is preferred.

· Target\-oriented, proactive, analytical and capable of independently managing multiple requirements.

**Qualification**

· MBA or related degree in Human Resources.

Pay: From ₹30,000\.00 per month

* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund

title: Cross Technology Managed Services Engineer (L2)
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**  

Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

**Your day at NTT DATA**  

As a Cross Technology Managed Services Engineer (L2\) at NTT DATA, you will play an essential role in maintaining our clients' IT infrastructure and systems. Your expertise will help keep everything running smoothly by proactively monitoring, identifying, investigating, and resolving technical incidents and problems. You'll be the go\-to person to restore services and ensure our clients' satisfaction.  

  

Your typical day involves managing work queues, addressing incidents and requests within agreed SLAs, and updating tickets with the actions taken. By identifying, analysing, and logging issues before they escalate, you'll be instrumental in maintaining service quality. You'll also collaborate closely with other teams and clients to provide second\-level support, ensuring seamless communication and efficient problem resolution.  

  

You will execute changes meticulously, understanding and mitigating risks, and contribute to the change management process with detailed documentation. Your role includes auditing incident and request tickets for quality, recommending improvements, and identifying tasks for automation to enhance efficiency. Additionally, you'll handle client escalations with professionalism and assist in disaster recovery functions and tests when necessary.  

  

Working within our diverse and inclusive environment, you'll help drive the optimization of efforts by working with automation teams and supporting L1 Engineers. Your responsibility also extends to contributing to various projects, ensuring that all changes are approved, and maintaining a positive outlook even in high\-pressure situations.  

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:*** Moderate\-level experience in managed services roles handling cross\-technology infrastructure.
* Knowledge of ticketing tools, preferably ServiceNow.
* Familiarity with ITIL processes and experience working with vendors and third parties.
* Proficiency in planning activities and projects, taking changing circumstances into account.
* Ability to work longer hours when necessary and adapt to changing circumstances with ease.
* Proven ability to communicate effectively and work across different cultures and social groups.
* Positive outlook and ability to work well under pressure.
* Commitment to placing clients at the forefront of all interactions, understanding their requirements, and ensuring a positive experience.
* Bachelor's degree in IT/Computing or equivalent work experience.
